name: glaze-workspace
description: Glazelab monorepo — @glazelab/core, framework wrappers, and the playground.

scripts.size: corepack pnpm --filter @glazelab/core size && corepack pnpm --filter @glazelab/react size
scripts.test:unit: vitest run tests/displacement.test.ts tests/m2-explicit-video.test.ts tests/react-material.test.ts packages/react/tests/components.test.tsx
scripts.test:consumers: corepack pnpm --filter @glazelab/react build && corepack pnpm --filter @glazelab/example-react-vite build && corepack pnpm --filter @glazelab/example-next-app build && playwright test -c playwright.consumers.config.ts
scripts.quality:v1: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm size && corepack pnpm test:unit && corepack pnpm test:v1 && corepack pnpm test:v1:production && corepack pnpm test:consumers && corepack pnpm test:packed-consumers
